items.title: Fraud Detection and Transaction Monitoring
items.description: Real-time ML models identifying fraudulent patterns in payment networks, futures margin calls, commodity trading irregularities, and insurance claims — trained on Chicago-specific transaction patterns and calibrated for the false-positive sensitivity appropriate to each use case. Typical cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.

items.title: Credit Risk and Underwriting AI
items.description: ML models for commercial and consumer credit risk scoring with FCRA adverse action reason codes, ECOA fair lending disparate impact testing, and SR 26-2 model validation documentation. sections.title: Chicago-Specific FinTech Regulatory Compliance
sections.description: Chicago's FinTech AI market has unique regulatory requirements shaped by its derivatives and futures market position.

items.title: CFTC and NFA (Commodity Futures)
items.description: Chicago's derivatives market is regulated by the CFTC and NFA — AI systems involved in trading decisions, risk management, or compliance surveillance for futures and options businesses face specific CFTC algorithmic trading rules (Regulation AT) and NFA compliance requirements distinct from SEC-regulated investment advisor AI.
items.label: CFTC · NFA

items.title: Federal Reserve / OCC (SR 26-2)
items.description: Model risk management guidance applying to Chicago banks' ML models used in credit, fraud, and risk decisions. ClickMasters delivers SR 26-2 aligned model validation documentation as standard for all banking ML clients.
items.label: SR 26-2

items.title: Illinois Department of Insurance
items.description: State insurance regulators in Illinois oversee AI use in insurance underwriting and claims — fairness testing and documentation requirements apply to insurance AI deployed in Illinois.
items.label: Illinois DOI

items.title: FCRA / ECOA
items.description: Adverse action reason codes and disparate impact testing for consumer credit AI — required for any ClickMasters credit scoring engagement regardless of Chicago's additional regulatory layer.
items.label: FCRA · ECOA

sections.note: Definitive regulatory compliance determinations require qualified financial services and regulatory legal counsel. ClickMasters provides technical implementation and documentation.
